title: Investment Management
description: Track holdings, market value and returns. Buys and sells are never counted as spending.

list.title: Portfolios
list.empty_description: Create a brokerage account first, then bind it as a portfolio.

create.title: New portfolio
create.account_hint: Only brokerage accounts can be bound, and each account maps to one portfolio.
create.account_empty: No brokerage account available. Create one on the accounts page first.
create.name: Portfolio name

holdings.title: Holdings
holdings.empty_hint: Record a buy to start tracking value and returns.
holdings.no_price_hint: Without a price, market value and unrealized P&L stay empty. Record a price first.

performance.title: Performance
performance.empty_hint: Returns require historical prices, so the curve starts once you begin recording prices.
performance.twr_hint: TWR removes the effect of deposits and withdrawals, measuring the strategy itself.
performance.xirr_hint: XIRR reflects the time value of the money you actually invested, including timing.
performance.snapshot_points: {{count}} points use a manual valuation snapshot rather than recalculated prices.

allocation.title: Allocation
allocation.empty: No holdings, allocation cannot be computed
allocation.targets_mismatch: Target weights in one dimension must sum to 1; current total is {{total}}.
allocation.rebalance_hint: The following are suggestions only. Nothing is traded automatically.
allocation.rebalance_category_note: Suggestions by asset class require you to pick specific instruments.

trades.title: Trades
trades.empty_hint: Buys, sells, dividends and fees all appear here.
trades.confirm_void: Voiding also reverses the ledger entry. Continue?

trade_form.title: New trade
trade_form.category_hint: Dividends, interest, fees and taxes need a category, otherwise income and spending stats drift.

cashflows.title: External cashflows
cashflows.empty_hint: Record deposits and withdrawals so returns exclude the effect of money flowing in and out.
cashflows.confirm_delete: Deleting a cashflow also reverses the ledger entry. Continue?
cashflows.hint: Buys, sells, dividends and fees are not external cashflows and do not belong here.

actions.confirm_archive: Archived portfolios leave the default list, but trades and history are kept. Continue?

basis.note: Portfolio value = account cash + securities market value. Cash is never double counted in net worth.
basis.buy_not_expense: Buys and sells are asset conversions, not income or spending.
basis.dividend_income: Dividends and interest count as income; fees and taxes count as spending.
basis.stale_hint: Prices have not been updated for {{days}} days; market value may be out of date.
basis.unpriced_hint: These instruments have no price, so their value is 0 and P&L is not computed: {{symbols}}.

valuations.title: Valuation snapshots
valuations.hint: For periods without prices, a manual snapshot supplies the total market value. Recalculation still wins whenever prices exist.
valuations.delete_confirm: Deleting this snapshot marks the point incomplete again if no price exists. Delete?
valuations.overwrite_confirm: A snapshot already exists for this date. Overwrite it?
